description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). What is returned depends on the member's plan; the result says what was included. Derived readings for a symbol or GLOBAL, with ONE `bias` that says its source: the regime read's bias for SPX, SPY and QQQ when your plan includes reads (written by Joule), otherwise the readings' own. Default: the LATEST value of each reading (with `fresh` and `age_min` while the session is open) plus up to 12 dated `changes`. Give `at` (HH:MM ET), `history` {from, to, every_min >= 5} (60 points max) or `metric`; `detail` 'all' lifts the 12-change cap. Node readings for SPX, SPY and QQQ are VEX (vanna) nodes and differ from the ladder's gamma nodes by design; for gamma nodes at a time use quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder, and over time quantgeeks_get_node_history. Quote readable strings as written.

at.description: HH:MM ET: the readings as of that time.

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the newest session with stored data for the symbol (an overnight session dated today counts).

detail.description: 'summary' (default): up to 12 changes; 'all': every change of the session.

history.description: A compact series instead of the latest values.

name: quantgeeks_get_readings
title: Derived readings
